risk_note: Payment path, RV2, no money effect. The singletonKey of the biz.reconcile fulfilment job gains app_id (biz:<app_id>:<biz_type>:<biz_ref>, D10-1030): under the dual-brand setup two app_ids holding the same biz_type and biz_ref no longer share one key, where the later job would be swallowed. bizReconcileKey takes appId and its two callers (pay-settlement.ts, pay-refund-result.ts) pass the app_id of the same order as the payload; within one app one business object keeps one key, so fulfilment stays serial per object (BR-PAY-01). Payload, queue, amounts, vouchers and states are unchanged. pay.enabled is still off, so no queued job crosses the key change. A task branch with evidence because payment is in MONEY_PATHS. The tests come first and go red (D10-1078, D10-1083): the ledger's renames leave seven files out of the red run (CT-06zzzzl), result/concurrency keeps a prettier reflow and is judged by test, with one declared red_exempt.
